caption: The drawing depicts a small figurine of a person dressed in dark clothing with yellow trim, a brown pointed hood, and a long white beard, standing on a greenish-brown rectangular base. The figure, which resembles a gnome or dwarf, has one arm raised and is holding a small object in its hand. Positioned to the left of the figure is a rectangular structure resembling a red brick chimney with black mortar lines, featuring an open top. The background is plain and unadorned, and the artist's signature "C. Herring" is visible in the lower left corner. The colors present in the drawing mainly include red, black, brown, yellow, white, green, and beige tones.
title: Toy Bank: Santa Claus
